translationNote.ru: Русские названия и описания — редакционный перевод для атласа; английские сохранены из клиента. Имена предметов без проверенного перевода показываются в оригинале.
translationNote.en: Russian names and descriptions are editorial translations for this atlas; English is preserved from the client. Items without a reviewed translation retain their original names.

meta.heroSource: Skin/Loading/Loading_01.dds (original loading artwork; not a location screenshot)

itemStats.validation: Every complete 124-byte equipment record matched the archived original ItemInfo table; fixture offsets differ from archive layout. Unknown stat indices remain explicitly unresolved.

wings.descriptions: Editorial summaries of verified native stats; original tooltip text preserved separately; exact item IDs are never merged.
wings.displayPolicy: Identical names, full equipment attributes, requirements, original descriptions, model and icon are merged. Raw IDs and exact loot evidence remain available under source details.

bossLoot.definition: An exact item ID is unique to this boss within the 150 decoded GOP monster pools. This is source association, not a rarity tier, drop guarantee or a claim about unexamined servers.

skillAccess.visibility: Current installed Send-LocalSkillList includes saved and access-eligible records; later records are appended. Rank 0 is listed but not learned. Immediate visibility of every future skill in the original game is not confirmed.
skillAccess.rankPolicy: Original rank costs verified byte-for-byte. Current local access uses the same minimum level for every rank; no extra rank-specific level gate exists.

npcServices.validation: NPC identity, model, shop IDs and five service pairs read from original GOP; current service additions, adopted stock and dialogue roles labeled separately.

classEquipment.selection: Highest original minimum level no higher than the selected tier 40, per class-compatible visible slot; strongest enhanced Fine variant at that level. Equipment requirement is not asserted to be a character level cap.

presentationUpdate.monsterLevels: Min/max known original GOP levels across unique TBK monster placements, including bosses; per-variant ranges are kept separate and unresolved levels are labeled.
presentationUpdate.identifiers: Internal references retained; zone/item identifiers removed from rendered labels.
presentationUpdate.monsterAI: AI row omitted from monster profiles.

description.ru: Проводник новичков: движение, инвентарь, направление к Джеку и заключительные уроки. Начальная точка длинной учебной цепочки.
description.en: Newcomer guide: movement, inventory, directions to Jack and advanced lessons. Starts the long tutorial chain.

greeting: Welcome to Monato Esprit!
Welcome to all who follow the moonlight into our world of dreams.

description.ru: Проводник в подземелье Newbie Training. Исходное задание: Rabid Rabbit ×4 и Yellow Rabbit ×3. После прохождения цепочка продолжается письмом Джанго.
description.en: Guide to the Newbie Training dungeon. Original objective: Rabid Rabbit ×4 and Yellow Rabbit ×3. The chain continues with a letter to Django.

greeting: Welcome to our world.
I'm sure you will enjoy your stay here with us.

description.ru: Участник учебной переписки с Реей и Беллой. С ним связаны услуги зачарования: цель, свиток, порошок и стоимость проверяются перед изменением предмета.
description.en: Part of the tutorial correspondence with Rhea and Bella. Associated with enchanting: the item, scroll, powder and cost are checked before modifying equipment.

greeting: There's nothing quite like farming, is there?
I sure do enjoy a quiet country setting.
I just wish these monsters would leave us in peace.

description.ru: Обучает ближнему бою и умениям. Задания требуют двух Leek, затем двух Leek Mage и одного Leek Warrior; награда за урок навыков предполагает выбор одного вида зелий.
description.en: Teaches combat and skills. Objectives require two Leeks, then two Leek Mages and one Leek Warrior; the skill lesson offers a choice of one potion type.

greeting: Nice to meet you, traveler.
My job around these parts is to teach newcomers about combat.

description.ru: Обучает алхимии: изучение рецепта со свитка и изготовление зелий из материалов. Учебная практика требует три малых красных зелья.
description.en: Teaches alchemy: learn a recipe from a scroll and craft potions from materials. The practice objective requires three Small Red Potions.

greeting: It's always nice to see someone new!
Aren't you curious about what wonderful things will be in this new world?

detail.ru: Обучает изучению рецептов и изготовлению зелий через учебную цепочку.
detail.en: Teaches recipe learning and potion crafting through tutorial quests.

description.ru: Объясняет MetaTIX и ведёт дальше к Джанго. В локальной версии кошелёк использует игровую валюту; оригинальный внешний платёжный сервис не восстановлен.
description.en: Introduces MetaTIX and sends you to Django. The local version uses in-game currency; the original external payment service has not been restored.

greeting: Hello, friend.
This world can be very beautiful...
But always keep an eye out for danger!
Would you like to learn how to turn Ore into Ingots?

detail.ru: В заданиях обучает превращать руду в слитки.
detail.en: Quests teach turning ore into ingots.

greeting: There's nothing I love more than smelting!

detail.ru: Ремесленные задания о плавке металлов.
detail.en: Craft quests about metal smelting.

greeting: You can recycle Metal into all sorts of things!

detail.ru: Задания о переработке металла.
detail.en: Quests about recycling metal.

greeting: I like to build boards from little scraps of wood.

detail.ru: Ремесленные задания о работе с древесиной.
detail.en: Craft quests about working with wood.

greeting: I'm still learning how to recycle scraps of wood.

detail.ru: Задания о переработке древесины.
detail.en: Quests about recycling wood.

greeting: I love to weave thread into fine fabrics!

detail.ru: Задания об изготовлении ткани из нитей.
detail.en: Quests about making cloth from thread.

greeting: I'm still learning how to weave thread into fabric.

detail.ru: Задания начинающего портного.
detail.en: Apprentice tailoring quests.

greeting: I can teach you how to utilize pieces of crystals in many ways.

detail.ru: Задания о применении осколков кристаллов.
detail.en: Quests about using crystal fragments.

greeting: By combining pieces of crystals, you can create unique crystals you can't easily find.

detail.ru: Задания о соединении осколков в кристаллы.
detail.en: Quests about combining fragments into crystals.

greeting: I'm experimenting on new ways to use crystals.

detail.ru: Задания о новых способах применения кристаллов.
detail.en: Quests about new ways of using crystals.

greeting: If you ever need to brew some new potions, come find me!

detail.ru: Задания об изготовлении зелий.
detail.en: Quests about brewing potions.

description.ru: Урок «Облегчить ношу» и магазин. Связан с сумками и дополнительным пространством инвентаря; наличие предмета Pouch не доказывает полную поддержку его механики.
description.en: The “Lighten the load” lesson and a shop. Associated with bags and extra inventory space; a Pouch item does not by itself prove full mechanic support.

greeting: Buying and selling can make your life much easier when fighting nightmares.

description.ru: Урок полировки и магазин. Ремонт и Refine — отдельные механики: восстановление прочности нельзя приравнивать к улучшению качества.
description.en: Polishing lesson and a shop. Repair and Refine are distinct mechanics: restoring durability is separate from improving quality.

greeting: Going into battle with nice armor makes even the hardest task seem easy.

description.ru: Урок «Устройство» и магазин. Исходная роль прослеживается по Gac-диалогу и зависимостям учебной цепочки.
description.en: The “Gizmo” lesson and a shop. Its source role is documented in the Gac dialogue and tutorial dependencies.

greeting: 'Gizmo' is the most interesting word I have ever heard.

description.ru: Урок изготовления предметов и магазин. Завершение открывает заключительные уроки Вебера и дальнейшее знакомство с Исильдрой.
description.en: Crafting lesson and a shop. Completion unlocks Weber’s advanced lessons and the introduction to Isildra.

greeting: I think Barker is insane. He keeps sending people to talk to me!
I come from a long line of weaponsmiths!
Do you have any blades that need sharpening?
You can never be too safe when it comes to armor!
I think your outfit could use some mending.
Remember to drink your potions!
My recipes are delicious and nutritious, too!
Every Archon needs a good pair of wings.
I have quite a collection of them myself.
Greetings.
The world of alchemy is quite enchanting!
We should all use our skills to help the unfortunate.

detail.ru: В исходной таблице помечен как алхимик. Подтверждённое окно услуги — зачарование; изготовление зелий у этого NPC не подтверждено.
detail.en: The source table identifies this NPC as an alchemist. The confirmed service window is enchanting; potion crafting at this NPC is unconfirmed.

greeting: Sometimes people remind me of flowers. I guess I'm a little obsessed, huh?
Whenever I see you, I get the urge to experiment. Hahaha!

detail.ru: Участвует в исходной цепочке получения профессии. Начните с направления Зои; точные поручения показаны в сюжетном маршруте.
detail.en: Participates in an original profession-acquisition chain. Start with Zoe’s referral; the exact errands appear in the story roadmap.

greeting: My beautiful accessories will add some sparkle to anyone's day.
But it's hard to stay cheerful with all the trouble going on.
I'm always worried about Grape. I hope nothing bad has happened to him.
I see fate has guided you to me.
Maybe someday you'll be as strong, dashing and brilliant as I am.
You've still got a long way to go!

detail.ru: Участвует в исходной цепочке получения профессии. Начните с направления Зои; точные поручения показаны в сюжетном маршруте.
detail.en: Participates in an original profession-acquisition chain. Start with Zoe’s referral; the exact errands appear in the story roadmap.

renderEvidence.name: Puma
renderEvidence.rendering_limitations: Static source geometry preview. Primary original crystal effect meshes included where directly attached; particle emitters, glow trails and original effect scheduling are not simulated.

greeting: Hwarang must study art and ethics as well as swordplay.
My lady hasn't sent me any mail lately.
I wish she would write to me more often.

detail.ru: Участвует в исходной цепочке получения профессии. Начните с направления Зои; точные поручения показаны в сюжетном маршруте.
detail.en: Participates in an original profession-acquisition chain. Start with Zoe’s referral; the exact errands appear in the story roadmap.

previousCatalogName.en: Hwarang must study art and ethics as well as swordplay.
previousCatalogName.ru: Hwarang must study art and ethics as well as swordplay.

greeting: There are too many sad faces nowadays. I hope things get better soon.
I see an uncommon glimmer in your eyes. There's something special about you.

detail.ru: Участвует в исходной цепочке получения профессии. Начните с направления Зои; точные поручения показаны в сюжетном маршруте.
detail.en: Participates in an original profession-acquisition chain. Start with Zoe’s referral; the exact errands appear in the story roadmap.

greeting: Too many people have been hurt.
I hope things get better soon.
We all have to pull together.
What do you think you're doing around here?
I'm sorry.
I've been a little on edge lately.
These dark times are tough on everyone.
Don't expect to rest here until you cough up some money!
Pipe down!
My customers are trying to sleep.

previousCatalogName.en: Don't expect to rest here until you cough up some money!
previousCatalogName.ru: Don't expect to rest here until you cough up some money!

greeting: Welcome.
Your belongings are safe with me.
What would you like me to hold for you?

detail.ru: Объясняет выбор профессии на Lv 5 и выдаёт направление к наставнику храмовника, воина Хваран, мага или целителя.
detail.en: Explains the profession choice at Lv 5 and provides a referral to a Templar, Hwarang, Mage or Cleric trainer.

previousCatalogName.en: Welcome.\Your belongings are safe with me.
previousCatalogName.ru: Welcome.\Your belongings are safe with me.

greeting: Hello, and welcome.
Why don't you take a look around Isildra?
I know a few quiet spots to relax in the shade.
I'm so exhausted!
My son never listens to me anymore.
I never thought fatherhood would be so hard.
Salutations.
I'm quite upset with my father.
Isildra requires stronger leadership in this, our darkest hour!
All this work is making me thirsty. Do you have anything to drink?
I don't think I'll ever finish this construction!
Is there a problem?
Unless you have official business, please move along.
Sorry, I'm not allowed to talk while on duty.
I've heard that somewhere to the east is a grand city.
You should train yourself here before venturing out into the unknown.
Can you feel the hot winds blowing in from the desert?
You'll have to train hard before you're ready for those rough lands.
I've heard that everyone in the South is so rich that they party every day.
I wouldn't put much faith in those stories.
To the north is a magnificent city called HolinHigh.
Dress warmly, though. I hear that it's freezing up there.
What do you think you're doing around here?
I'm sorry.
I've been a little on edge lately.
These dark times are tough on everyone.

previousCatalogName.en: What do you think you're doing around here?
previousCatalogName.ru: What do you think you're doing around here?

greeting: It's nice to see you.
If you're planning on venturing out into the wild, take a weapon with you.
You can never be too safe these days.
Are you getting accustomed to life in Monato Esprit?
I wish you would take more care to protect yourself.
There's no shortage of sturdy shields around here.
Sorry, I'm not allowed to talk while on duty.
Sorry, I'm not allowed to talk while on duty.
Guild matters are my specialty.
If you want to create a Guild, talk to me.
It's exhausting to run long distances all the time, right?
I have a teleporter service that can help you to move faster from city to city!
You can buy and sell items at my market.
The market is a convenient place to make trades with other Archons.
Who are you?
I'm sorry, but I'm far too busy with my
investigations to talk right now.
Dr. Julian does all of his experiments on that
bridge to the west.
He has a great mind for science
and problem-solving.
This is the perfect weather for growing flowers.
Take a stroll through my garden, but watch where you step!
It takes plenty of work to keep this garden so beautiful.
Those Nightmares make my job a lot more difficult.
Welcome to Dr. Julian's research lab.
You won't find much conversation out here.
Most of the local residents bite.
Sorry, I'm not allowed to talk while on duty.
Playing all day can be hard work.
It's hard to raise a family in these troubled times.
Farm fashions are so boring!
Noon-day sun on the fields... is there anything better?
Don't sneak up on me like that!
You remind me of a friend I once had long ago...
If I had some fishing bait, this day would be better.
That's some fine armor you're wearing.  Did I make it?
A few knocks with this hammer and I can fix just about anything!
Logic and reason are the two principles I follow.
Superstition will get us nowhere.
The nightmares make it hard to keep my shelves stocked.
At least I have so many enthusiastic customers.
Feeding Holinhigh is no small task!
I'd give you a free sample, but I don't have enough food to spare.
My enchantments are guaranteed effective.
Show me what you have, and I'll make it better.

detail.ru: В исходной таблице помечен как алхимик. Подтверждённое окно услуги — зачарование; изготовление зелий у этого NPC не подтверждено.
detail.en: The source table identifies this NPC as an alchemist. The confirmed service window is enchanting; potion crafting at this NPC is unconfirmed.

greeting: If you wish to speak with Baldwin, please be respectful.

previousCatalogName.en: If you wish to speak with Baldwin, please be respectful.
previousCatalogName.ru: If you wish to speak with Baldwin, please be respectful.

greeting: Behave properly while inside Atira Temple.
I am pleased to see you, my child.
Your strength gives hope to this world.
My Bank will keep your extra equipment safe and secure.
The Roths were once the most powerful family in Monato Esprit.
I must restore my family's honor.
Someday, I'll be running this city!
Standing beside the Crystal Tower always puts me at ease.
Eat right and get plenty of sleep.  That's the key to a long life.
Welcome to the Merchant Guild's National Headquarters.
Big companies like us will always crush the little guys.

previousCatalogName.en: Welcome to the Merchant Guild's National Headquarters.
previousCatalogName.ru: Welcome to the Merchant Guild's National Headquarters.

greeting: The fashion business isn't always pretty.
I can barely afford fabric these days.

previousCatalogName.en: The fashion business isn't always pretty.
previousCatalogName.ru: The fashion business isn't always pretty.

greeting: Are you ever curious about what your destiny will be?
Down south, Kalla Lake was once a popular vacation spot.
Now it's surrounded by monsters.
To the east, Cherry Blossom Village is one of the prettiest places in Monato Esprit.
Security gets tighter after every monster invasion.
I don't know why anyone would leave out of this gate!
Welcome, traveler.
Our city is under constant threat of attack, so please be careful.
I'm Ajax's second-in-command.
Don't believe a word that liar Biff says.
Ajax trusts me most of all.
Dirk will try to tell you otherwise.
Special Agent Vince at your service.
I'm the one who really keeps this city running.
If you need help, please speak to Vince.
Guild matters are my specialty.
If you want to create a Guild, talk to me.
It's exhausting to run long distances all the time, right?
I have a teleporter service that can help you to move faster from city to city!
You can buy and sell items at my market.
The market is a convenient place to make trades with other Archons.
Halt!
Who wishes to enter the Temple of Eternity?
Between you and me, this place is a little dead.
I wish I could get a livelier assignment somewhere else.
This forest was once a peaceful sanctuary.
Something has corrupted many of the trees here.
I only wish that the forest would become pure again.
You must help others if you have the power.
My services bring comfort to those in need.

previousCatalogName.en: You must help others if you have the power.
previousCatalogName.ru: You must help others if you have the power.

greeting: You must be a seasoned traveler to come all the way out here.
Just don't find yourself on a monster's dinner plate!
Welcome, friend.
This place is protected by the honored Templars.
Have no fear of danger here.
Take a break from your travels, friend.
Our fine village is protected by the Templars.
Sorry, I'm not allowed to talk while on duty.
Sorry, I'm not allowed to talk while on duty.
Welcome, friend.
This city is protected by the honored Templars.
Sorry, I'm not allowed to talk while on duty.
Sorry, I'm not allowed to talk while on duty.
I can't let you pass unless you pay the toll.
Proceeds are split between the gate-owner and the city.
Halt right there!
This gate requires a toll.
If you want to see Kalla Lake Area, you'll have to pay the toll.
Taxes like these help fund the city's defense.
It's nice to have company now that all my workers are gone.
I'll defend my sawmill to the bitter end!
Kalla Lake has the tastiest fish in all of Monato Esprit.
Catching them is much harder now that they're walking around!
I hope the Defense Force doesn't ruin my crops.
Being in command is a lot of responsibility.
Are you in need of help?
Quick, get inside the perimeter!
Our Defense Force keeps this village safe, for now.
We can barely hold back these monsters. Our forces are too small.
It takes more than a strong sword-arm to fight the nightmares.
Who needs armor when you've got a sharp sword?
Earth tones are a perfect choice this season.
If you need any help, don't hesitate to call for my assistance.
A meal made with love is medicine for the soul.
I wish I could visit strange and exotic places like you do.

detail.ru: В исходной таблице помечен как алхимик. Подтверждённое окно услуги — зачарование; изготовление зелий у этого NPC не подтверждено.
detail.en: The source table identifies this NPC as an alchemist. The confirmed service window is enchanting; potion crafting at this NPC is unconfirmed.

greeting: My Bank has a proven record of reliability.
Put your trust in me, and you will not be sorry.
Our forces are stretched thin across the city.
No matter what happens, we will not surrender.

previousCatalogName.en: Our forces are stretched thin across the city.
previousCatalogName.ru: Our forces are stretched thin across the city.

greeting: Making a difference takes more than prayers. It takes action!
If you don't have any business to conduct, please move along.
If not for the Light of Guidance, or city would surely be lost.
We owe them a great deal for their selfless bravery.

previousCatalogName.en: If not for the Light of Guidance, or city would surely be lost.
previousCatalogName.ru: If not for the Light of Guidance, or city would surely be lost.

greeting: Remember that battle can only take you so far.
Do not let this war with the nightmares consume you.
Anyone who fights these monsters is a friend of us farmers.
Hello!  We don't get many vistors these days.
My inn has the most beautiful hostess in town, me!
We've got to pull together if we ever want to survive.
I wouldn't go into the north if I were you.  There are too many monsters running loose.
I wish that someone could ease the princess's burdens.
Remember that you are a guest while inside the palace.
What brings you here?  Do you need any help?
What we need most of all is compassion for those in need.
Sometimes I wonder if our leaders really know what they're doing.
But I'll obey their orders nontheless.
Never fear, the Light of Guidance is up for any challenge!
Turn back, friend. There are too many nightmares out here.
Nice to meet you, traveler!
I'm in charge of the supply unit in Raon.
Security is at an all-time low in Raon.

dialogue.text:
What can I do for you, citizen?

I would like to start a Guild.

I see.  Do you have the appropriate paperwork?

Paperwork?

Of course.  All new guilds must be approved by Lord Salvador.

Guilds are a great responsibility, and therefore Lord Salvador wants to
personally speak to each new Guild Master before granting their request.

I see.

If you make a good impression on Lord Salvador, he will write you a Guild
Consent Letter.

Okay.  Where is he now?

He is at his home, in the northeast area of town.  
Once you bring me his consent letter, you will be able to start a guild.

Okay.

To start a Guild, you need a Letter of Consent from Lord Salvador.
He is in the northeast area of town.

Lord?

Yes, I am Lord Salvador.  What do you need?

I heard that I need a letter from you to start a Guild.

Ah, so you wish to become a Guild Master. 

Yes.

I'm a little busy at the moment, so we will keep this brief...

What do you think a Guild is?

Well... it's a group of people who gather together to cooperate and help each
other for the greater good.

Excellent.  And what you do think are the duties of a Guild Master?

To keep the guild organized and lead it wisely.

Will you be able to do that?

It's a great responsibility, but I think I'm up for the challenge!

Hmm, you seem to be more than qualified for the task.  
Please wait while I write you a Letter of a Guild consent.

Thank you.

complete

Here is your Guild Consent Letter.

[You have received a Guild Consent Letter from Lord Salvador.]

Thank you.

Do not forget to honor your responsibilities.

I will try my best.

Give this to the Guild Master and she will
allow you to start a Guild.

Thank you very much.

The Guild Master is located near the stable in the northwest of town.  
Give her the Letter.

Did you receive your Consent Letter?

Here it is.

Hmm, everything appears to be in order.

Can I start my guild now?

Yes, you can get started with your guild.
Good luck, and have fun with the other citizens of Isildra!

I sure will!

complete

Nice to meet you, traveler.
My name is Weber, and I'm a guide here. 

My role is to assist newly arrived Archons. 

Would you like to hear a few tips on how to get around? 

Yes, I think a few pointers will help. Everything is so new here.

Don't worry, you'll become a veteran in no time.

That's good to hear.

First, I'll teach you how to move around. 

To walk to a location, move your mouse cursor over it and left-click.

Simple, right?

I'm following you so far.

Good, now continue listening carefully and I'll tell you more.

You can look around by holding down the right mouse button and moving the
mouse around.

To zoom in and out, roll the mouse button wheel up and down.

Zooming in gives you an eye for detail, while zooming out lets you keep a broad
perspective. Ha ha.

That's it!
Now you know how to move and look around.

I'll give you a Quest to try walking around. You can hit the (Q) button to
check your Quests. When you're finished, return to me. 

Okay, a little walk sounds nice for my first Quest.

To move, left-click on your destination. To look around, hold down the right
mouse button. To zoom in and out, scroll the mouse wheel.

I think I'm getting the hang of it.

And it's such a nice day.

Is there anything else I should know?

Plenty, but you don't have to learn it all right now. Come back to me when you're
ready for more.

dialogue.text:
Now I think I'll teach you about your inventory.

Your inventory is the space where you put all the items you earn during your
adventures. Of course, there's a limited amount of space in your inventory.

To open your inventory, click on the Inventory button at the bottom-right of
your screen. You can also use the shortcut button (B) to open your inventory.

Gotcha...

Your inventory is divided into two sections. The top shows all the items you
currently have equipped. The bottom shows everything else you are carrying.

To equip an item, right-click on the item or left-click on it and drag it onto the slot
where you want to put it.

Some items have certain requirements before they can be equipped. If you
don't meet the requirements, you won't be able to equip the item.

I understand.

Consumable items like potions can be used by right-clicking on them. 

You can also drag consumable items into your Quick Bar at the bottom of the
screen. You can use an item in your Quick Bar by clicking on it or pressing the
number that matches its slot on your keyboard.

You have two rows of ten slots each in your Quick Bar, so be sure to use it!

Now why don't you explore your inventory and get back to me?

To open the inventory, click on the Inventory button or press (B). To equip an
item, drag it into your upper inventory. To use an item, right-click on it, or put it in
your Quick Bar and press its number on your keyboard.

You're back. Now I'll give you a shield and you can practice putting it on.

Okay, let's see how it fits.

Now that you've learned all the basics, I'll send you to Jack to learn the next
step in your training.

Okay.  Thanks for all your help!

No thanks are necessary. It's my job! When you're ready to go to Jack, come
back and I'll tell you where he is.

dialogue.text:
I'm glad to see you again.

Well, it's a pleasure to see you as well. Bella said that there is still one final step
in my training.

Yes.
You've learned all the basic lessons, but now it's time that you learned your
advanced lessons. 

Advanced lessons? 
I'm sure that you already taught me everything I need to know.

Did you know that you can hit the (Z) button to toggle on and off your GUI?

What?  Really?

See?  You still have a little to learn,  so come back when you're ready.

Oh, I suppose so.

To learn your advanced lessons, please talk to me again.

To become a full citizen of Monato Esprit, you will have to join a class.

A class?

Yes. A class is like a job. Right now you're just a Novice. When you join a
class, you will receive many new and special skills.

To join a class, you must first reach level 5 as a Novice. Once you reach level 5,
you won't grow any further until you join a class. 

Your next step is to visit the town of Isildra. Be sure to talk to Zoe, and she
will be able to help you.

Zoe will tell you all about the classes you can choose from. They range from
stalwart warriors such as Templars to powerful spellcasters such as Mages.

The important part to remember is to visit Zoe in Isildra once you reach level 5. 

Hmm... then I only have one question: how do I get to Isildra?

I will give you an Escape Scroll as a graduation present, which will
teleport you directly to Isildra.

Oooh, that sounds like fun!

When you get to Isildra, don't forget to pay your respects to Salvador, the lord
of the city. 

He sounds like someone I'd like to meet.

You've been a very quick learner. 
When you're ready to go to Isildra, use this Escape Scroll.

complete

Are you ready to go find Jack?

Yes.

Then just follow this road to the north. 

Oh, that's easy.

Be sure to let Jack know that I sent you.

Will do.  Thanks for all your help.

You can find Jack by following the road to the north.

Hello, Jack.

You must be a newcomer to Monato Esprit.  Nice to meet you.

Weber sent me to see you. He said you'd have some lessons to teach me. 

Ah, a new student, then. Excellent.
Come back and see me when you're ready to begin.

dialogue.text:
Excuse me, but I have some important things to tell you.

Really?  Then I'll listen closely.

As you may have already learned from Django, the population of monsters is on
the rise. Nightmares have been finding their way into our dreamworld and
damaging our communities. 

Yes, 
I've noticed all sorts of strange creatures running loose.

Nightmares can take the form of almost anything. Sometimes they are scary,
but sometimes they appear harmless.  

There are harmless Nightmares?

No.  
All Nightmares are dangerous,  so don't be fooled.  

It's important for strong Archons like you to fight against the Nightmares before
we're all overrun.

So what should I do?

I need you to go into my dungeon and hunt some of the monsters down there.
It will give you good practice and grant poor Django some peace. 

I will give it a shot.

Thank you.  
To enter my dungeon, speak to me again and select "Enter Dungeon."
Once you're inside, hunt 4 Rabid Rabbits and 3 Yellow Rabbits,
then return to me. 

Okay.  
I'll come back in a moment and enter the  dungeon. 

To enter my dungeon, speak to me again and select "Enter Dungeon."
Once you're inside, hunt 4 Rabid Rabbits and 3 Yellow Rabbits, then return to me. 

I have defeated the monsters. 

Thank you.  
The more Nightmares you drive away,  the fewer will be around to harrass the
other citizens. 

I'm glad to be helpful.

As a token of my appreciation, I have prepared a little reward. I'll also write a
letter to Django to let him know that the problem has been resolved.

dialogue.text:
Hello again.

You're back! 
Here is a letter to Django explaining that his problems have been resolved. 

That should calm his mind a bit.

Please give Django his Letter.

Good day, Django!  
Here's a letter from Rhea.

Oh, a letter, eh?  
Let's see what it says...

Well, this is good news indeed!

Thank you for delivering the news. Now I can relax a little bit. 

My pleasure.

But I still feel guilty for letting Bella worry about me...

I'll want to send a letter telling her how I'm doing.  
Please give me a few moments to write it out. 

complete

I've summed up my thoughts and am ready to talk. 

Tell me everything. 

You're new here, so you might not have realized how different our world has
become.  

Not too long ago, Monato Esprit was a paradise of imagination. Now it's home to as many monsters as peaceful Archons.

Is there something I can do?

Actually there is. My friend Rhea traps monsters in her dungeon. If you could
defeat some monsters in there…

It would help the citizens in these parts a great deal.

You've got it. 
Please head down to the southeast and find Rhea. She'll have to explain the
rest. I'm getting tired.

Don't worry.  I'll be right back. 

Travel to the southeast and talk to Rhea.

Hello, are you Rhea?

Yes, that's me.  
What brings you to my shores?

Django sent me here.  
He said there was some sort of problem with monsters.

Ah, I see. 

If you're willing to help us out with this problem, talk to me again.

dialogue.text:
Hey!  Come on in!
I have just finished writing the letter. 

Please deliver this letter to Bella.  Knowing her, she's still worried about me.

I'll rush it right over to her.

Please deliver the letter to Bella.

Hello!

How are you doing today, Bella?

Splendid.
Have you solved Django's problem?

Yes, I fixed everything. He sent you this letter.

Ah, I'll read it right now...

Oh... what a relief!
I'm glad that he's doing well now. I just wish he had told me about his problems
right away, instead of trying to take care of them by himself.

I really appreciate your efforts.

Oh no problem...
I enjoy helping the fine people of Monato Esprit. 

When you say things like that, I can't help but give you a token of my
appreciation. 

Let me find something special. Come back when you reach level 5 and I'll

dialogue.text:
Are you ready to learn a few hard lessons?

I suppose so...

Good. As you may have known, the world of Monato Esprit has become
dangerous. You'll have to learn you to protect yourself.

Yikes!

I'm going to teach you about battle. 

I hope you're a good teacher.

Before we get down to that, remember everything that Weber taught you about
inventory. If you don't recall, I can explain it to you again before we go to
the next step.

To open the inventory, click on the Inventory button or press (B). To equip an
item, drag it into your upper inventory. To use an item, right-click on it, or put it in
your Quick Bar and press its number on your keyboard.

Okay, I think I'm ready.

Alright!
Now, put on this training gear and come back when you're ready to get your
hands dirty.

dialogue.text:
I think you're ready to learn about battle. 

Yep.  I'm ready to go! 

The first thing you do is left-click on a monster that you want to attack.
This will highlight the monster. You can also hit the Tab button to target
a nearby monster.

Once you've highlighted a monster, left-click on it again or hit the Space
Bar to attack it.

If you're far away from the monster, you will automatically move toward it before
you start attacking. 

Okay, I'm ready to get started! 

Well, practice makes perfect. 

Nightmares have turned some of the harmless leeks around these parts into
monsters. Find two Leeks and defeat them. 

No problem. 

To attack, left-click the target to highlight it, then left-click again to attack.

I'm back.
Those Leeks didn't stand a chance!

Well done.
That's two Nightmares that these farmers won't have to deal with. 

So, do you understand the basics of attacking?

Yes, but those Leeks hurt! Their attacks lowered my HP.

Ah, I'm sorry.
I forgot to talk to you about that.

Uh huh.

Enemy attacks will lower your HP, so be careful! If you lose all your HP, you will
lose consciousness. 

Don't worry, though. The forces at work inside Monato Esprit will protect you and
bring you back to the nearest safe spot. 

I'm glad to hear that!

Of course, it's always best to protect yourself.

If your HP gets too low, you can use potions to restore them. Here's a Healing
Potion to try out, but only use it when you need it. 

You can also heal your HP by going to a Crystal of Restoration, like the one you
were standing next to when you came to Monato Esprit.

I remember that crystal.  It's very impressive.

The Great Architect made sure to put crystals all over Monato Esprit to protect
us Archons.

That was a wise decision. 

Yes, and he made several types of crystals as well. Red, blue, and yellow
crystals exist, and I've even heard of a black crystal somewhere out there.
Red crystals restore health, blue heal mana, and yellow heal both.

So you see, there are many ways to heal yourself in your adventures through
the dream world. 

Do you think you've understood everything I've told you?

I believe so.  I'm ready for more action!

Excellent!
Then why don't you try it out yourself?

Sounds good.
I'm a hands-on kind of person. 

Well then, you can either use the potion I'm giving you or go to a Crystal of
Restoration to heal yourself, and then come back and talk to me.

dialogue.text:
Ah, you're back.
Now I will give you your next battle lesson.

I'm ready to learn.

This lesson is about skills.

Skills?

Yes, skills are special abilities that all Archons have. To see what skills you
have, click the 3rd button on the Main Menu or press the shortcut key (K) to
open the skill window.

The skill window is divided into Active Skills and Passive Skills. Passive Skills
are always in effect, but you must use Active Skills directly. 

As you level up, you will earn Skill Points that you can use to learn new skills.
The more Skill Points you put into one of these new skills, the more powerful
the skill will become.

So to use new skills, I'll have to put at least one Skill Point into them?

Yes, but don't try to use your Skill Points yet. You already have points in three
Novice Skills. Once you join a class, you will open up new skills to learn. 

When you put a Skill Point in a Passive Skill, you don't need to do 
anything more, since the skill is always "on". But for an Active Skill,
you'll need to click on the skill's icon to use it.

So I have to leave my skill window open all the time?

No, silly! You can use your shortcut bar. Drag the skill you want to use down into
a slot on your shortcut bar and close the Skill Menu. Now you can use the skill
any time.

If you spend a whole battle fiddling around with menus, you'll be gobbled up
before you get one shot off!

Ah... I think I'll just use the shortcuts.

Smart move. 

Skills work in different ways. Some skills require you to click in the skill icon first,
and then select a target. For others, you must select a target first and then hit the
skill icon. 

I guess I'll just experiment with each skill.

Well, there goes another potential customer. Come back when you're ready
for your first lesson.

Haha, okay.

When you're ready for your first lesson, talk to me again.

"Alchemy" is just a fancy word for making things out of other things.
There are many types of Alchemy, but I'll stick to teaching you how to
combine items to make new ones. 

Okay, that's fine with me. 

The easiest things to make with Alchemy are potions. 

That's good.
I can always find a use for potions.

First, you need to find an Alchemy Recipe to learn how to make something.
Once you find a Recipe, right-click on it in your inventory to learn it. 

The next step is finding the ingredients to the recipe. 

How do I know what ingredients I need?

First, open up your Alchemy Window either through the Main Menu or by
pressing the shortcut key (A). 

In the Alchemy Window, select the Recipe you wish to make on the left side
of the window.

When you select a Recipe, its ingredients will appear on the right side
of the window. 

Some recipes need only three types of ingredients, but others may need as
many as six types.

How do I get ingredients to make a Recipe?

You take them from monsters you defeat during your adventures, or trade for them
with other Archons. 

Once you have all the necessary ingredients for a Recipe, click the Create
button and it will produce one finished item. The item will go into your inventory,
so make sure you have enough space beforehand.

If you run out of ingredients for a Recipe, you won't be able to make any more of
that item until you get more. You can't bake a cake without sugar!

Now, enough of my blabber. Why don't you try it yourself? I'll give you the Recipe
and materials to make a Small Red Potion. Try to make one and then talk to
me again.

Please wait a second. I will tell you as soon as I'm done compiling the operation
planning documents. 

Please don't make me wait too long! I'm dying to go and kill some monsters. 

complete

I can't believe that the situation has become this bad. I really can't look my
queen or our people straight in their eyes. 

Is the situation that bad?

I haven't mentioned it yet, but there has been a big curveball thrown at our
military operations since the loss of the battle in Sinye Colony. With the current
conditions, we might not even be able to continue with our minimal security patrol
in Raon. 

Is there something I can help with?

I really appreciate the gesture, but the commanding office has come to the
conclusion that we have already passed the point that individuals can help out
and make a difference.

Then, what are you going to do? Will you be using the last resort as you have
mentioned earlier?

With current situations, we have no choice but to receive help from the
'Light of Guidance' and the holy knights.

What do you mean by help from the 'Light of Guidance'?

The Light of Guidance's, Farrah has requested the dispatching of knights in
exchange for the protection of Lime's followers since the security has
weakened so much in Raon after the battle in Sinye Colony. I believe that
there are already some troops stationed near Raon already.

We were trying to resolve the problem without getting them involved, but it
seems inevitable that we would need their help.

If you received help from the holy knighthood, the situation might not have
become this bad.

This issue is not that simple. Regardless of their motives, they are still an outside
force. Allowing them to practice their military powers in Raon might cause
some political sensitivity. 

We also have to take into account the fact that the relationship with the holy
knighthood, which is a subset of the Lime, has not been so strong, and how
the people might feel about that. 

So, you are telling me the choice to receive aid from the holy knighthood and
'Light of Guidance' is not only up to the commanding office to make the decision.

In simple words, yes. The final approval can be made by the Princess. Whoa, I
can't sleep at night knowing that our young Princess has to deal with making
this burdensome decision. 

But, what can we do! If we don't take their help even now, then we won't be
able to guarantee the safety of our people. Since the situation is so bad,
I think we have no choice but to ask her to make that decision. 

I'm not sure on all the details, but it looks that there will need to be a very
important decision made. 

I don't know if I'm out of line here, but I hope there will be something that I can
help with. 

Actually, I don't think I'm worthy to see her. So, I was just about to ask you to
deliver this 'Request Document' to our Princess.

And please tell her that I, Ian is ashamed that I was not able to fulfill my duties,
but I will someday get our Sinye Colony back.

I got it. I will deliver this document to the Princess. I hope that you will see some
great results. 

I hope that we could exterminate all the monsters in the near future and see the
smile on her face.

Hello Princess!

Oh it is great to see you again, Mr. Traveler!

I'm hoping to see you with good news, but it doesn't seem like that's the case
this time.

Are you here per Ian's request?

Since you mentioned it, I guess I'll get straight to the point. Ian has requested
me to deliver this document to you. 

I guess that we have no choice but to ask them for help. Anyway, do you know
if the people of Sinye Colony were able to safely evacuate? How is the treatment
of the wounded soldiers coming along?

I don't know about the exact details, but I overheard from someone that the
people were able to safely evacuate. I didn't have a chance to ask about the
details since the general was so pissed after reading the reports. 

I see. We are getting so much help from you, who is a guest of ours. I hope
someday we can see you again in peaceful Raon.

I too am looking forward to that day.

complete

dialogue.text:
You may not know since you haven't been to the Sinye Colony yourself, but the
situation seemed very hostile. 

According to Kong, even the border safety where the troops are stationed is
questionable.

There is no sense in talking about what happened in the past regarding the
failure of the operation, but because of it everything has gone south including:
our troops, supply aid, and even the morale.

Considering that we won't be able to execute huge operations like last time
with our current military power, it seems imminent that we utilize what we have
now and secure influence in the Sinye Colony. 

What do you mean by securing influence in the Sinye Colony?

Currently, we must restrain the monster forces as much as we can with the fact
that it has been captured by the monsters. 

We will run our operations in that we will minimize the loss of our troops as much
as we can, while utilizing the remaining troops and supplies and added forces
from Raon in exterminating the monsters. 

However, that can't be the foundational solution.

That is correct. As I have mentioned earlier, this is our last resort in restraining
the monsters' forces. In other words, this operation is focused on stopping the
monsters from advancing.

Ah hah! While you are slowing down the advancement of the monsters, you will
plan for a big attack.

Yes. What we need right now is recruitment and training of additional
troops and stocking up on our supplies. In order to do that, Kong must utilize his
troops as much as he can to trap the monsters in the Sinye Colony.

Here, this is an ordering document regarding the Restrain Operations.
Please deliver this to Kong as fast as you can. We must start our operations in
Sinye Colony ASAP.

Alright! I will be there in no time. 

This is pressed for time. Please deliver this to Kong right now.

(catching breath) General, General!

What is it that you are in such a hurry about?
Has the Commander in Chief sent out an order or something?

That's right! Here is an ordering document from General Ian. Take this.

Oh! It is an ordering document from the commander in chief. You are here so
fast, not even too long after document has been formed. I think the
commanding office understands the seriousness of the situation this time. 

Whoa, I will be here catching my breath. I'm about to pass out, since I ran here
straight without taking any rests. 

Alright, I will be taking a look at this document, why don't you rest here and
quench your thirst.

complete

How was your journey here to Raon?

The surrounding countryside is filled with monsters!

Yes, they're right outside our walls.

I'm glad to see that the city watch has been able to keep them out of the city.

Perhaps I can help out in some way.

You wish to join the city watch?

No, I don't think I could guard one spot all day.  

I'm better at finding problems and helping people.

Well there are plenty of problems that need solving.

Is the situation that bad?

General Ian and Chief Adviser Tia are working very hard, but they can only do
so much.

If you want to help, go find Princess Jasmin.  She's in charge of the city.

Raon is ruled by a princess?

Yes, Raon has been ruled by princes and princesses since the beginning. 

Interesting.  I'd like to meet a princess.

Find Princess Jasmin by the Pavilion in Raon.

Princess Jasmin?

Yes, I am Princess Jasmin.  

Wow, you don't look anything like what I expected.

You must be very surprised by how young I am.

Yes.  You don't look any older than me.

I haven't ruled Raon for long, and it's been difficult right from the start.

I can imagine.

I don't think I've seen you before.

Is it your first time here in Raon?

Yes, I'm still pretty new to Monato Esprit.

I bet you've seen more of the dreamworld than I have.

Why is that?

I'm too busy ruling Raon to go anywhere.

That's too bad.  You should be able to take a vacation every now and then.

When my people are no longer suffering, then I can relax.

I'd be glad to show you around whenever you want.

That sounds nice.  Maybe one day.

In the meantime, I'd appreciate anything you can do to help the citizens of my
poor, troubled city.

Certainly.  You might be surprised by what I can do.

complete

I hope that you haven't been waiting for long.

Not long at all.

It sounded like you have some questions about the Light of Guidance.

I'm more interested in the current situation here in Raon.

Oh, well I have a whole introduction to the Light of Guidance memorized.
Can I begin with that?

Sure, if it makes you happy.

The Light of Guidance was created as a charity for Archons who are in need of
divine help. Since the arrival of the nightmares, however, our duties have
expanded to protect all of Monato Esprit from darkness.

Clerics fill a majority of our ranks, but the Light welcomes Archons of all classes.

Now can I ask questions?

Yes, go right ahead.

What's this I heard about military tensions between Raon and Holinhigh?

Ah yes. War between Archons is almost unheard of in Monato Esprit, but we did
come close once.

What happened?

When nightmares first arrived, some people thought that Mages from other
cities had sent the monsters to attack them.

Someone in Raon started to do experiments with Dark Crystals and
caused an explosion.

That doesn't sound like a good idea.

I wouldn't mess around with Dark Crystals unless I knew what I was doing.

So what happened next?

Well, Raon thought it was under attack, and started recruiting its citizens to war.

Luckily the Light of Guidance got involved and talked everyone down.

If not for us, Raon might have invaded Holinhigh over a misunderstanding.

It sounds like the Light of Guidance plays a big role in politics.

That has become one of our most important duties.

So you went from a simple charity to defenders of the peace. 

We keep an eye on the big picture, but we don't forget about helping individuals
in need.

Why don't we turn this conversation to present times. I've heard that Holinhigh
troops are being dispatched to Raon and other places.

The Light of Guidance always sends troops where they are most needed.

Just because we are based in Holinhigh doesn't mean that they get us all to
themselves.

Even so, it seems like Holinhigh needs them just as much as anyone else.

If Holinhigh takes a turn for the worst, we will certainly recall our troops to help
defend the city.

I suppose so.

Oops.  Excuse me, but I have to take care of something for a moment.
Could you wait a minute?

Not a problem.

Talk to Farrah again.

Are you still busy?

Well, it appears that Jordan is having some sort of problem.

What's wrong?

I'm not exactly sure.  His report is strangely vague.

Maybe he couldn't go into specifics for some reason.

I don't know what he expects me to do. I don't know what the problem is, and I
can't go meet him to find out.

Why don't you send some reinforcements to help him.

What reinforcements?  We're already short on troops.

Well, I could stop by and ask what he needs.

Oh, that would be helpful.  

I'll get the specifics from him and see what can be done.

Good idea.

I'll write up some orders for you so that he knows that you're on official business.

I don't see why that would be necessary, but I'll wait.

This will only take a moment.

complete

Alright, it is ready. Please take this 'Request Document' to the templar who
is leading the dispatched troops. 

Where are they located at approximately?

They should be stationed at Hobaki's Cottage located on the outskirts of
Raon. You should be able to find them there. 

Hobaki's Cottage you say? I remember passing through there, it shouldn't be too
hard to find it. 

I can give you quick directions. Exit thru the East gate and go toward Sinye
Colony. You should reach a side road on the left after a while, and you follow
that. 

I heard that there are many monsters nearby, so please be careful on your
way there. 

I'm not too scared of them, since I have encountered almost every type of
monster existing in Raon.

I see. I don't mean to rush you, but it is very time sensitive, so please hurry.

I'll leave right now!

If you stay on the road at all times, it should be safer.

Hello! Are you Jordan?

Yeah, I'm Jordan. Who are you? What is it regarding?

Oh, I'm a traveler who's delivering this 'Request Document' to you on behalf of
Farrah. 

What! Why are you delivering such an important document? Well, there must be
a story behind that. I'll listen to it later, but give me the document first. 

Here is the 'Request Document' Farrah has asked me to give you.

<<Handed off the 'Request Document'.>>

So, they had to ask for help like this. They should have accepted our help
when we offered it. Thanks to them, we just wasted several days in this filth.
What a waste of time. Pshh!

I am quite surprised to see how lousy of a job the administrative official is doing,
making us waste so much time here like this. Unbelievable. 

Has it been a long time since you have been deployed here?

You are still here? If you are done with your task, why don't you go back now?
This is an operating area. There is not much to do for newbies like you.

A newbie? Hey! I have already encountered all types of monsters. 

Oh yeah? You must be talented regardless of how you look. Why don't
you utilize your skills and help us out a little here?

You keep looking down on me. Try me. I'll blow your mind. 

Alright then! Hold on a second. I'll find something that would fit your skill level. 

complete

Ok, why do you think Jordan is crazy?

Jordan... seems a bit weird. When I delivered captain Felix's order
documents, he got really upset and…

Wait, hold on a second.. Order documents from Felix? Why is Holinhigh's
manager Felix all of a sudden sending out an order document? No, wait.
Why did he give it to you in the first place?

(Hmm... Why is everyone making such a big deal out of the fact that I have
delivered this document?)

Since I was on my way to Holinhigh anyway, I was only helping out Felix with
his request, since I have met him a few times before.

Alright, that's fine. But, what did he exactly say?

He told me to deliver this to Jordan. He also said, "Everything will go as planned.
It doesn't matter anymore if everyone finds out."

He must have been very irrational. Either way, sorry that you had to be put
on a spot. We were trying to take care of it discreetly, but it looks like that there
will be some drama over this.

Well, we just need to achieve the results we want, so it shouldn't matter either
way!

What are you talking about exactly? You all have a secret plan here in Raon?

What do you mean that we are working on something together? We are only just
finding this out. It's just the way we found out about this stuff was the problem.

What exactly were you trying to find out?

If you want to find out what we were curious about, please meet with
Jung and ask him. And, please relay this message to him.
"I hope that we won't have to use our last resort."

It should be easy to find him, since he is probably praying near the 'Warning Bell'.

Excuse me, are you the Great Budhist Monk Jung?

I'm Jung, but I wouldn't exactly call myself a Great Budhist Monk..
Anyway, you seemed to have been all over the place...
what brings you all the way over here?

Something seems to be up with Jordan and the Light of Guidance's junior
official Farrah. They were saying something about that they need to find
something out and told me to relay this message, "I hope that we will not
have to use our last resort" to you. I'm not exactly sure what is really
going on.

It is the result of people not completely understanding the teachings of Lime who
are trying to find out something that is to be remain unknown. Even if they do
know, they should already know that they will not be able to use it for
themselves.

What is it that they are trying to find out? Can you tell me what that is? 
I'm really curious! It's driving me crazy!

What they are trying to find out is what is called the "Light Warrior". 

The Light Warrior? What is that?

complete

Excuse me, have you passed through the Barren Land recently?

Fairly recently.  Why?

Did you happen to notice any troops there?

I saw some soldiers at a security checkpoint.

Anyone else?

Not that I can recall.

Hmm, that's not right at all.

Is there something wrong?

Orders are getting muddled now that everyone is under pressure from these
monsters.

I have to get a report of the current situation from Jean.

How can I help?

If you're free, could you deliver some Orders to Jean?

Certainly, that's no trouble at all.

And if you're free afterwards, could you see if you could help Jean with anything?

I'm always free to help the common good.

That's what I like to hear.  I wish there were more Archons like you!

Oh, I'm nothing special.  So long!

Please deliver my Orders to Jean.

Captain Jean?

I don't have time to pose for any more portraits!

No, it's not about that.  I have some Orders for you.

Orders?

Let me see those.

Once you've read the Orders, I'm free to help out.

Are you, now?  Give me a moment to peruse this document.

I'll wait right here. 

complete

dialogue.text:
Let's see what I can find for you to do.

Well, since you're so good at hunting nightmares, we'll start with that.

Ah good. I'm much better at fighting monsters than I am at painting fences
and tap dancing.

I'll keep that in mind.

Do you have any preferences on which monsters to fight.

I think the worst nightmares are those Ogre Brawlers. They're strong and very
aggressive.

They won't pose much of a problem for me.

Excellent.  I knew that you would come in handy.

Come back after you've defeated twenty Ogre Brawlers and I'll have more tasks
for you.

I'm off!

Please defeat twenty Ogre Brawlers, then return to me.

I'm back from Ogre hunting!

Phew!  You certainly smell like Ogres.

Do I?  Ugh!  I guess I do...

Don't worry.  Just take a stroll through a flower garden and you'll smell just fine.

I guess this is a common problem for people around Raon?

Sour smells are the least of our problems.

Is something on your mind?

Oh, I'm just thinking about the Saulabi Army.

Saulabi Army?  That sounds familiar.

Yes, you might have seen those creatures that look like Archons dressed
in blue uniforms.

Oh, yes.  It's very eerie to see nightmares that look like Archons.
I wonder why they look like that.

The nightmares must have taken them from our thoughts.

They're an ancient fairy tale, sort of a bed-time story that Archons used to tell
to their kids.

In the stories, the Saulabi were a nation of cruel and aggressive people who
made war on every peaceful nation that bordered them.

What happened to the Saulabi?

There are many different stories, but one is the most popular.

What happens in that one?

They invaded so far from home that their army plunged off the edge of the world.

Wow!

If only we could find the edge of the world, we'd take care of them all at once!

Haha! I don't think it will be that easy. It was only a story, while these nightmares
are real.

I guess you're right.

Anyway, the moral of the story was that you should not be too greedy or cruel.

That's true.  These nightmares probably didn't understand the story.

Yes. Their attacks can't go on forever. Someday they may just burn themselves
out.

We just have to stand firm until they do.

With your help, it might just be possible.

complete

dialogue.text:
These Bandits are driving me crazy!

Something wrong?

Yes, these Bandit nightmares are stealing everything! They look like
thieves from those old adventure stories.

Ah, I think I remember those. The hero would always get kidnapped by a bunch
of thugs…

But he'd use his wits and brawn to escape.

Yes, well, now the Bandits are real, and they're everywhere!

I'm a bit of a hero.  Maybe I can help.

Yes, maybe you can. Try to defeat twenty Bandits, and we'll see if you're
worthy of a story.

You'll be reading about me in no time!

Defeat twenty Bandits, then return to me.  

It was an adventure, but I'm back.

Excellent.  You really are a hero from legend!

Being a hero is fun, but not everyone wants to live in a legend.

Yes, it's far too dangerous for most Archons to live with these monsters.

The sooner we can make the dreamworld safe again, the better.

I agree.

dialogue.text:
The damage caused by Orge Brawlers was worse than I expected.

I'm not really surprised.

I also just received word that the Bandits have stolen more crops than we first
thought.

We're going to have to get more active against these nightmares.

What do you want me to do?

I need you to go on another hunting mission.

Which nightmares should I defeat this time?

We need to target both Bandits and Ogre Brawlers at the same time. 

Okay.  I'll defeat twenty of each.

Defeat twenty Ogre Brawlers and twenty Bandits around Raon, then return to me.

Phew!  That was a tough fight.

Don't be afraid of a little sweat.

Yes, that was quite a workout, but I feel good.

If we keep this pace up, we might make some headway.

Let me at 'em!

I can do this all day!

complete

This just isn't working!

What's not working?

Anything!

Nothing I do seems to have any effect at all!

Don't be too hard on yourself, Tia.

The nightmares are giving everyone problems.

But I'm the Chief Advisor!  I'm supposed to know how to solve problems!

No one has figured out how to solve the nightmare problem yet.

Maybe that's just because everyone is relying on me, and I'm failing.

You can't think like that.

I know.  I just get so frustrated sometimes.

It feels like I'm letting everyone down.

I just wish that I could think of something.

You've got me.  We can think of something together.

That's part of the problem.

I'm relying on you too much, when you could be helping someone else.

I think I'm going to have to let you go.

Are you firing me?

No, no!  I'm just going to send you to someone else.

Oh really?  Who?

I think General Ian would be able to make good use of you.

You mean the guy standing right next to us, staring off into the distance?

Yes. He's a very deep thinker, which is why he's never bothered when I conduct
my business right next to him.

Take this letter and make sure to tap him on the shoulder so he notices that you're
talking to him.

If you think that it's for the best, then I'll do it.

Talk to General Ian.  He's standing right next to us.

Hello there, General!

Hmm...?  Did you just say something?

Yes, I said, "Hello there, General!"

I've got a note here from Tia.

From Tia?  Why does she only talk to me through letters?

I wonder about that too.  She's standing right over there.

I think that she doesn't want to break my concentration.

A lot of people are counting on my strategies for protecting the city.

I guess that makes sense.

Now let's take a look at this letter...

Take your time.

Oh no!  It says here that Sinye Colony has fallen to the nightmares!

This is very bad news.

What are we going to do about it?

Tia has made strategic suggestions in the letter.  I'll have to think about it...

Don't take too long.  People are counting on you.

complete

Would you mind taking a trip to Sinye Colony?

I thought that region was captured by the monsters.

Yes, the situation is pretty bad.

The villagers must have evacuated back to the city, right?

Actually, no.  They're very stubborn and are still hanging around the area.

They must need help, then.

Yes, I was hoping you could meet up with General Kong to help in the relief
efforts.

Sure, that sounds like something I can do.

Please meet with General Kong.

General Kong?

Please, no autographs.  I'm very busy.

No, no.  Tia sent me to talk to you.

Oh, I see.  

So you're here to help?

Yes.  Tia said there were refugees from the Sinye Colony that need some help.

We could all use some help.

I'll go wherever you need me. 

I'll have to look over some of my documents first before I decide.

complete

The situation in the Barren Land is much clearer now.

That's great to hear. Then, all we have to do is to exterminate those monsters,
right?

We would if we could, but our troops are very weak right now.

So what are we going to do?

I've got a plan for these circumstances.

Please take these Orders to Captain Jean and stick around to see if there's
anything he needs.

There must be something about me in these Orders.

You will find out the details once you meet with Captain Jean.

I guess I'd better get going.

Please deliver my Orders to Captain Jean.

I have here Orders directly from the Chief Advisor.

They must be important.

Here they are.

This is a thick document.  Why don't you go relax while I read it all.

I could use a break before all the action begins.

complete

Here, take this Evil Seed.

Um, okay.  What do I do with it?

Do with it?

Yes, I'm not going to just carry this nasty thing around with me.

No?  Ah, no.  Of course not.

So what should I do with it, oh wise Advisor?

Hmm... how about you give it to Seo?

Sounds like a plan to me.

Really?  Good, then get going.

Deliver this Evil Seed to Seo, in Isildra.

Here, take this Evil Seed.

Um, okay.  What do I do with it?

Do with it?

Yes, I'm not going to just carry this nasty thing around with me.

No?  Ah, no.  Of course not.

So what should I do with it, oh wise adventurer?

This all seems very familiar to me...

Actually, this Evil Seed is very interesting.

I should study it very thoroughly.  Thank you for bringing it to me!

Um... no problem!

complete

It looks like we should have reinforcements sent to the Barren Land
soon.

That's good to hear.

Yes, but it's going to be a very difficult process.

We still have very few resources available to us.

Why is that?  I thought that Raon was a rich city.

It is, but the nightmares are far worse than anything we have ever faced.

We simply weren't ready for this level of danger.

When will Raon be ready?

That's a complicated question.

I'll give you a moment to think it over.

Speak to me again to hear my answer.

Well?  When do you think Raon will be ready to face the nightmares?

We will never be completely ready.

Never?

You mean we'll lose?

No, I just mean we will never be in a perfect position.

We'll just have to keep fighting no matter what happens.

complete

You're curious about the Light Warrior legend?

Sure, why don't you tell me about it?

It's actually a very dark story.

Don't worry.  I don't get nightmares.  I fight them.

Haha, that you do!

So, come on.  Tell me about it.

Okay. The Light Warrior was a legendary being of great power who
supposedly looked after Raon long ago.

The people built a giant bell to summon the warrior whenever they were in trouble.

So they'd ring the bell and he'd show up and fix the problem?

Yes. At first they only rang the bell for emergencies, but over time they used it
more and more.

So they were getting lazy?

Yes. At the first sign of a problem, they'd just ring the bell and let the Light Warrior
handle it.

And he didn't get mad?

No, just the opposite.  He liked to solve problems.

Well, everything sounds fine to me.  Why is this a dark story?

Because the Light Warrior was doing so much already, he started to do things
without being asked.

Hmm...

And he was so powerful by that point that no one could stop him when they
didn't want his help.

I can see where this is going.

Pretty soon the Light Warrior became a tyrant over the city, doing whatever he
thought was best at the expense of everyone else.

I guess the moral of this story is that you have to solve your own problems
yourself .

Now that I understand the legend, I should go talk to Jasmin.

You should go visit Princess Jasmin, by the Pavilion.

Still gazing out onto the pond?

Yes,  Sometimes I wish we had a Light Warrior of our own.

But wouldn't that be a disaster?

Sometimes I think that the Light Warrior would be a good trade-off to the
nightmares.

No, the whole point is that we can't hand over responsibility to someone else.

I suppose so.  I just have to accept my role as Princess.

And I'll accept my role as a slayer of nightmares!

I don't think anyone doubted you about that.

complete

Excuse me.  Could you do me a favor?

Certainly.  You look so sad.

All the Seeds that I saved up all year were stolen by Bandits. I don't know
what I'm going to do next year.

How can Bandits get at your seeds if there are so many soldiers guarding the
area?

I have no idea.  You'd think we'd be safe.

Have you tried talking to Jordan or other soldiers?

They keep saying that they're too busy to talk to me.  

That doesn't make any sense at all. They should be able to hunt down some
of these Bandits and get back your Seeds.

My son went off to the cities to fight, and I'm left all alone without even the local
soldiers to help me.

Don't worry.  I'm not too busy to help you.

Currently, Ogres seem like the biggest threat in the Barren Land, so we're
concentrating on them.

Sounds fine to me.  I hate those ugly brutes.

If they keep expanding at their current rate, they'll soon cover all of
Monato Esprit.

Then I'd better get started!

Hunt 10 Ogres, 8 Ogre Warlocks, and 5 Ogre Brawlers and come back to me
once you're done. There's a bounty, of course.

A bounty?  You mean a reward?  Cool!

Hunt 10 Ogres, 8 Ogre Warlocks, and 5 Ogre Brawlers, then return to me.

That was a lot tougher than I thought.  Those Ogres are big!

Yes, so it's good that we have strong Archons like you standing up to them.

Thank you for the compliment... and the reward!

dialogue.text:
Okay, ready?  We've got a lot of work ahead of us.

Really?

High Command is telling me that we've got to hunt every type of monster in the
area. 

Hmm, that means Tindermen, Ents, Golems, and Ogres.  Do they want proof?

Yes. Tindermen drop Dry Wood, Spring Ents drop Twisted Wood, Golems drop
Golem Scrap, and Ogres drop Ogre Heads. You'll need five of each item to
meet your quota.

Yikes, that is a lot of work.

Is it too much for you?

Of course not!  I can do that as easily as I snap my fingers.  There, see?

Take all the proof and show it to Captain Jean.  Good luck.

Collect Dry Wood from Tindermen, Twisted Wood from Ents,Scraps from
Golems, and Heads from Ogres and deliver it all to Captain Jean.

I've been hunting everything under the sun!

That's easy to say, but do you have proof?

Of course!  Look at all this stuff I collected.

This seems to all be in order.

I don't know why you ever doubted me.

complete

Quick!  Get over to the Raon Command Post!

What?  Is this an emergency?

I don't know!

Then why are you screaming for me to hurry?

Because I need to use the bathroom and I don't have time to answer any more
questions!

Uh... okay.  I'll get going to the Raon Command Post.

Get to the Raon Command Post!

Hello Tia.  Were you looking for me?

Wow, you came quickly.

I thought it might be an urgent matter.

Not really.

Oh.

You know, I might have had something to tell you...

Yes?

Mmmm... nope.  I lost it.  Hmm... but maybe...

I'll give you some time to think.

dialogue.text:
Nice to meet you. I'm Kwon, the arsenal supervisor for the garrison in this region.

So you defend the stockpile of weapons that are used to protect this... Barley field?

Yes. The garrison defends every part of Isildra and its surrounding environs.

We supply weapons to anyone who will help us.

Oh, well then in that case, I'm very interested in helping protect all this poor
Barley. 

No so fast. Before you get anything, you'll have to show me your dedication.
Go defeat five Ogres and Ogre Warlocks, and then eight more Ogre
Brawlers. 

Wow.  Maybe I shouldn't have joked about the Barley...

Go defeat five Ogres and Ogre Warlocks, and then eight more Ogre
Brawlers. Return to me when you are finished.

Those Ogres are real brutes, but I finished the job.

The garrison's job is never finished... but you have earned yourself an item from
our arsenal.

Let's see what I want...

complete

On duty, sir!  Oh, never mind.

What?

The way you were rushing toward me, I thought you were my commanding
officer.

Sorry if I made you all jittery. 

The truth is, we're all a bit jittery.

Why is that?

Why do you think?

Because monsters are invading our world and nothing seems to stop them
from swallowing our entire civilization?

Yeah.  That.

Well, buck up!

Buck up?  That's all you've got to say?

Look at me.  I'm cheerful.

Then you must be insane.

Take a look at some of the troops around here and notice the expression
on their faces.

Yes, I suppose morale is pretty low.

You can say that again.

Maybe I could do something about it.  

Unless you know any good jokes, I suggest you talk to the Adjutant.

No one ever laughs at my jokes, so I'll talk to him.

Talk to the Adjutant about the troops' low morale.

I think you have a problem with your troops.

What do you mean?  I've got the best troops in Monato Esprit!

But their morale is rock-bottom.  They're so depressed that they can barely stand.

Hmm... do you know any good jokes?

No!  I don't know any jokes!  Alright?

Okay!  Short tempers are a sure sign of low morale.

Let me think about this for a little while and maybe I'll come up with something.

Think fast.

complete

I defeated the Tindermen. Now you have to give me some of your equipment.  

I didn't promise anything...but I suppose you can have one item. You're lucky

dialogue.text:
You know, you shouldn't lie.

What are you talking about?

I heard all sorts of stories claiming you fought this or that monster.

Sure, what's wrong with that?

There's no way you could have done it all.

You think I'm lying about my adventures?

Yes.  And you're lying about it now.

It's very rude to accuse someone of lying without proof.

You're the one who should produce some proof.

Otherwise, I'll just assume that eveything you say is untrue.

What do I have to do to convince you?

Hunt some Spring and Autumn Ents.

Okay, I will.

Wait a second! You have to bring back 10 pieces of Twisted Wood as proof,
so I know you're not lying.

You'll see how real I am!

Hunt 15 Spring Ents and 15 Autumn Ents. Bring back 10 pieces of
Twisted Wood as proof.

If I say I defeated Ents, then I defeated Ents.

Prove it!

Here, look at this Twisted Wood I brought back.

You could have found all that.  It proves nothing.

I give up.

dialogue.text:
Halt, citizen!

What's wrong, officer?

Are you, or are you not, the citizen who hunted all those Golems recently.

Golems?  I've hunted a few Golems.

Wow, that's so neat-o!

Uh, what?

Gosh, I wish I could go out and have adventures like you!

Well, people need Watchmen to guard the streets too.

Would you like me to go hunt some Golems just for you?

Golly, that'd be swell! Could you hunt 15 each of those Golems and collect 10
Golem Scraps? Could you? Could you?

Sheesh, that's a tall order... but sure!  Why not?

Yippee!

Hunt 15 each of those Golems and collect 10 Golem Scraps,
then return to me.

Here's those Golem Scraps like I promised!

Cool!  You really did it!

Of course I did.  You can do anything as long as you conquer your fears.

You are so wise.

I want to be just like you!

Well, uh, maybe some day you will be... officer.

dialogue.text:
Hey, you're that famous adventurer.

You don't look like much.

Looks can be deceiving.

Sometimes.

This time!  I'm a very successful adventurer.

I don't see it, honestly.

You're being very rude.

And besides, I don't have to prove myself to you or anybody.

Okay, I'm sorry.  I was being a little hard on you.

Yes you were.

I was going to ask you if you'd hunt some Ogres for us, but you're probably too
angry.

I'm not too angry to help the townsfolk.

Good. Go hunt 15 Ogres, 10 Ogre Warlocks, and 5 Ogre Brawlers and
bring back 10 of their heads.

Ten of their heads?  Yuck.

Are you going to do it or not?

You could at least say please, after all that rude talk before.

Sorry.  Now get going.  Please.

Hunt 15 Ogres, 10 Ogre Warlocks, and 5 Ogre Brawlers, and return to me with
10 Ogre Heads. 

Here are those... uh... heads.

Hmm, I guess I shouldn't judge a book by its cover after all.

You're just now figuring that out?

Yes, I still thought you were a wimp when we last talked.

Sorry, I'm just a judgmental kind of guy.

Well, I hope you've learned a valuable lesson today.

Yes, people will do anything you want if you insult them first.

Exact- hey!  What?

complete

If you want to find out about what Chief Advisor Tia is wondering about,
you should go meet my adjutant.

What's an adjutant?

Yes, he serves my second-in-command in charge of defending the Shrine area.

Don't you know his name?

Not really.  Just find a Hwarang by the Shrine who looks like an adjutant.

Um... okay.  

Go look for my adjutant by the Shrine.  You'll know him when you see him.

Are you Captain Jean's adjutant?

Of course I am!  What do you need?

I'm here to help in whatever way I can. I need to find what kinds of monsters are
around here.

We can use all the help we can get.

Anyway, you said that you are here to get a sense of the situation. What kind
of information do you need?

Well, Chief Advisor Tia had asked me to find out which monsters are appearing in
this area and how dangerous they are. 

Tindermen, Ents, Golems, and Ogres have all appeared in this area.
However, we don't have any additional information on how dangerous they are. 

Scouting missions have not been regular since the monsters arrived.

Maybe some of the troops will have something to tell you.

That's a good idea.  Thanks.
