dialogue.text:
We should deliver our findings to the Raon High Command.

Yes, I bet Tia is dying to hear our report.

Oh not only that...

What else do we need to report?

We've discovered all sorts of interesting artifacts from the local monsters.

Oh really?

We need to gather a whole collection of all the things we've discovered.

What kinds of things do you need?

Let's see...10 pieces each of Twisted Wood, Golem's Scraps, and Ogre's
Heads. And they also want 20 Evil Seeds.

Once you've gathered it all up, could you bring it to Tia?

Wow, that's a lot of stuff, but I think I can do it.

We're all counting on you.

I won't let you down.

Once you have collected all the items, please go over to the Chief Adviser Tia.

Long time no see, Chief Advisor Tia!

I see that you're in good health.

I've been getting plenty of exercise in the Barren Land.

I have a whole collection of strange things to give you.

Ah, yes.  I was expecting this.  

Once again, thank you for all your help.

Not at all.  Just let me know whenever you need help with something. 

complete

Ugh, I was afraid of this.

What's wrong?

These orders I received are very troubling.

Why is that?

They concern you, so I guess I should tell you.

All our troops are tied up with other orders. I have to use travelers like you to
clear out the local monsters.

I see.

I'm not too happy about this turn of events.

Don't worry.  We Archons of Monato Esprit are always willing to pull together.

It's good of you to say that, but I'm not sure that everyone shares your views.

You'll see.  I bet you get lots of volunteers.

Will you be my first volunteer?

Of course!  I would have run away already if I didn't want to volunteer.

What do you want me to do?

Take these Orders over to my adjutant, and he'll give you a new task.

Remember, my adjutant is the Hwarang by the Shrine.

You really ought to learn his name sometime.

Take my Orders to the adjutant, the Hwarang by the Shrine.

Here are some Orders from Jean.

Hello to you to!

Sorry, I'm just ready to get my next task.

Okay, I guess I'll read these orders and find out.

Hmmm...

Yes?  Yes?

Hold on.  I'm still reading...

Come on!  Come on!

This is going to take some time.

ARG!... ok

complete

Look at you, strutting around!

You must think you're king of the world!

Haha, yeah, a little bit.

Why is that?

Look at all the things I've accomplished.

Yes, you have done some fairly impressive things...

What?  Do you know of something more impressive that I could do?

Me?  No, I couldn't send you off to do... that.

I couldn't send you off to your doom...

Ha!  I laugh at doom.  Tell me what it is.

There is one creature that lurks in the Barren Land that no one can seem to
defeat. A juggernaut of twisted metal!

It's the Steel Golem.  Stay away from it if you value your life!

You just wait.  I'll turn that nightmare into a giant hunk of garbage.

Defeat the Steel Golem if you dare!

Phew!  That was a close one.

You can't mean...

Of course.  Mission accomplished!

It was an epic battle.  Maybe sometime I'll tell you about it.

You accomplish things that I could only dream!

Well, this is the dreamworld.

Fulfilling dreams should be a daily event.

Yes, I suppose so.

Do you have any other dreams that need to be fulfilled?

Actually yes. I dream of filling this land with troops who will defend the people
from nightmares.

I'm just one Archon.  How could I do that?

Go talk to Chief Advisor Tia.

She gets things done.

Okay, I'll give it my best shot.

Hold on a second and I'll write up a request document.

complete

Alright, take this Request Document to Tia.

Should I just hand it to her?

Yes, that's all you need to do.

That doesn't sound very hard.

I'm sure things will find a way to complicate themselves.

I guess so.  Bye.

Deliver my Request Document to Tia.

Surprise!  It's me again!

Oh, you startled me! I was just reading this report that some hero just defeated
the Steel Golem.

Double surprise!  That hero was me!

That's wonderful to hear.  

Now that you're in a good mood, why don't you look at this Request Document
from Captain Jean.

Captain Jean, eh?  Let's have a look.

complete

Ah, hello!  I was just looking for someone to deliver this report for me.

Are you short-staffed?

I barely have enough troops to form a patrol.

What are all these villagers doing here?

I had to evacuate them because the Colony was getting overrun.

They won't go back into the city, so they're staying here for now.

I need someone to deliver this report to General Ian.

Not Chief Advisor Tia?

She'll read it over his shoulder anyway.

I see.  I'll give it to Ian.

Deliver my report to Ian, at the Command Post in Raon.

I'm back again!

Good.  I was afraid you'd left for some other city.

I don't limit myself to one location, but I'm here now to deliver this report.

Ah, it's from General Kong.  He must have the whole thing solved.

That's a load off my back!

But you haven't even read the report yet!

A good general can see everything three steps ahead.

I don't think you should just assume that it's good news.

Are you saying that I'm not a good general?

I'm just saying that I saw the situation in Sinye Colony, and it's not looking good.

Oh dear.  I'd better read this report then...

complete

General Ian agrees with me.

About what?

We should wear down the nightmares by using as few resources as possible to do
the maximum amount of damage.

That sounds nice, but how are you going to do it?

It's going to be tough. We hardly have enough equipment to support the
villagers, much less a military campaign.

So what's the solution?

We'll have to make sure that our next attack is a smash success.

We should research the monsters beforehand, and drill our troops to
perfection.

That sounds like good soldiering to me.

I need to make up for my previous mistakes.

I'm sure you'll do great.

I've got a lot of work to do.

Oh dear, yes, look at all this paperwork.

Yikes.  That's a lot of planning.

I couldn't do any of it without my loyal helper over there.

Who, that Hwarang?

Yes, I can never remember his name.

Maybe you could see if there's anything he needs you to do.

Talk to my helper, that Hwarang standing just over there.

Excuse me, but are you Kong's helper?

I'm no mere helper!  I'm Adjutant First Class Quirloium.

You're a what?

No, that was my name.

Yikes.  I think I'll just call you "Hwarang."

Fine.  Everyone hates my name.

Yeah, it's pretty awful.

Was there something else you wanted?  Other than to insult me?

I'm not here to insult.  I'm here to help.

I've heard that you're very good at helping people.

I do try.

I've got a bunch of orders to hand out.  I guess I could give them to you.

Sounds fine to me.

complete

So these Masks have spells cast on them.

Something like that.

And the spells cause people to become afraid.

That does explain why my troops have been so ineffective lately.

How are they doing now that the spell is lifted?

Are they unafraid?

I wouldn't say that.

They still show some signs of fright when they come back from patrol.

Maybe the spell hasn't been completely lifted.

Well that sure is a pickle.

Hang on!  These Masks are all from Withered Matrons!

We need to collect Masks from Withered Elders.

Ah, yes!  We only countered half the spell.

Go out and collect ten Masks from Withered Elders and Withered Matrons,
then give them to the Monk.

You can count on me.

Good luck.  I hope someday we can repay you for all your help.

Collect ten masks from Withered Elders and Withered Matrons, then deliver them
to the Monk.

I'm back!

It looks like your meeting with General Kong went well.

Yes, I think we even outsmarted you.

Good, you figured out that you needed to collect Elder Masks as well.

That was all part of my plan.

What?  You already knew that we'd need both types?

Why didn't you tell me that from the beginning?

It's best if you learn for yourself.

You think I still need an education?

You should never stop learning.

Hmm, I suppose that's true.

Now give me those Masks.

I'm going to remove the spell from them.

So the spell will never come back again?

I'm not sure.

I guess we'll learn together.

complete

On the agenda are Saulabi Swordsmen and Saulabi Sorceresses.

Ah, we're finally going to get to work?

Yes, it's time we really go on the offensive.

Finally, we might accomplish something.

Be nice.  

Everything we've done up to this point has been very important.

If you say so.  What do you want me to do now?

Defeat twenty Saulabi Swordsmen and twenty Saulabi Sorceresses.
Bring me back their Certificates as proof.

Defeat twenty Saulabi Swordsmen and twenty Saulabi Sorceresses.
Bring me back their Certificates as proof.

Here you go.  Twenty Certificates for forty Saulabi nightmares.

Excellent work.

Now what?  I'm ready for more action.

Don't rush me.  I have to consult the agenda.

complete

According to my new intelligence, the Saulabi Officers are planning something
big.

Big?  How big?

We don't know yet.

Then how do you know that it's big at all?

Don't be cute.  This is serious!

We've got to figure out what those Officers are planning.

If they're planning something, they probably have it written down.

That's true.  Go hunt some Officers and look for Operation Documents.

Collect Badges and Operation Documents from Saulabi Officers,
then return to me.

We were right.  I found these Operation Documents.

Yes, it must be a very big plan.  Did you read the document?

No, it's all gibberish.

It must be in some other language. I'll have to study them carefully.

complete

I just can't read this Operation Document.

What do we do now?

If we can't learn their plans, we might as well just start to focus our attention on
the Officers.

If we wipe them out, they'll never get a chance to start their plan.

Sounds a little crude.

Hey, it's all we've got.

Unless you know any master linguists, you'd better start hunting Officers.

Don't worry.  I like to keep things simple anyway.  

Defeat twenty Saulabi Officers and collect 10 of their Badges as evidence. 

It must be really easy to become an Officer in the Saulabi army.

You defeated twenty of them?

I could have defeated forty more.  What's next?

complete

Hmm, my superiors are requesting a status report.

It's a bit early to start writing reports.

No, our superiors understand that we can never completely reclaim this area
with our current strength.

We just have to show that we're making progress.

What kind of evidence do we need to show progress?

Here's what you need to do...

Defeat twenty of each type of Saulabi nightmare. Got that? While you're at it,
collect ten Badges from Officers, and bring them to Chief Advisor Tia in Raon. 

This is a big responsibility.  I won't let you down!

Defeat twenty of each type of Saulabi nightmare. Collect ten Badges from

Long time  no see, Chief Advisor Tia!

I've heard stories about your adventures, and I wondered if they could

All of the good stories are true, and all the bad ones are lies.  Haha!

By the way, I've got Kong's status report for you.

Oh!  It looks like you are making very good progress against the Saulabi.

Now if only Kong can weaken the Saulabi's supply lines...

Next time I see him, I'll mention it to him.

complete

How did your meeting go with Chief Advisor Tia?

She was happy with our progress, but she wants us to attack the Saulabi
supply line.

Ah, that's a terrific idea.

Tia is always one step ahead with strategy.

So how do we do it?

We need to steal Saulabi items so they can't be used against us.

Go defeat fifteen Saulabi of each type and bring back twenty of their Battle
Rations.

I got it.  Twenty Battle Rations coming right up.

Defeat fifteen Saulabi of each type and bring back twenty of their Battle Rations.

You ask for Battle Rations, and you get Battle Rations!

Good.  Now the Saulabi will be weaker, while our troops will be stronger!

We'll kill two birds with one stone!

Leave the birds alone and keep fighting nightmares!

Yes, sir!

dialogue.text:
Feeling better?

Dynamite.

Great, because I've got some new orders.

Let me at 'em. 

We've got to disarm the nightmares.

I'd rather just defeat them.  

You don't understand. We need to collect their weapons after we defeat
them.

That way, other nightmares can't steal the weapons and use them again.

Ah, that makes sense.

We should concentrate on Bandits and their Clubs.

Oh, I hate those big Clubs they carry.  

Good.  Go get them and deliver thirty of them to Kong.

I'm on the move!

Collect thirty Bandits' Clubs and deliver them to Kong.

Hello Kong.  Is it your birthday?

Let me see... no.

I got you a present anyway.

Ah, Bandit Clubs.  Excellent.

If we can steal enough of their Clubs, they might back off a bit.

If not, then at least they won't have as many Clubs to whack us with.

It's sort of strange to think about nightmares using weapons.

Yes, I know what you mean.

Nightmares that look like Archons are much more common around here.

I wonder why that is.

Probably for same reason that they're much stronger around here.

Why is that?

I have no idea.

Hum.  That seems like something we should investigate.

I'll try to fit it into my plans.

Good idea.

In the meantime, please accept this reward for your hard work.

Thank you kindly.

dialogue.text:
It's been a little easier to fight the monsters now.

Oh?  Has the spell been completely broken.

People will always fear nightmares, but now they're not quite as afraid.

That's good to hear.

While you were gone, we discovered how to weaken the nightmares even more.

That's great news.  How do we do it?

Do you remember those Canes that the withered nightmares carry?

Yes, I think I recall that.

And you must have noticed that they don't limp...

Ah, so they really don't need the canes to walk with.

Right.  Those canes are sources of their power.

That's very clever.

I guess I know what the task is going to be.

That's right.  We've got to collect those canes.

I think we need twenty Canes.

I'll get started.

Collect twenty Canes.

These look like ordinary canes.

Yes, but they swing differently.

Oh yes, they feel a lot heavier when I swing them.

There's definitely something fishy about them.

Whatever it is, I'm glad they're out of nightmare hands.

Good job, by the way.

It's a pleasure to serve the people of Raon.

These nightmares are very cunning.

How so?

I've looked at these Operation Planning Documents we captured, but they're all
written in code.

So they're useless to us?

No, I think I can crack the code.

I just need a little time and some more information.

What kind of information do you need?

I need more documents. The more pages I get, the easier it will be to figure out
their code.

Hunt down some Saulabi Officers and bring back their Operation Planning
Documents.

Collect ten Operation Planning Documents from Saulabi Officers,
then return to me.

Here are those documents you wanted.

Good, now I'll get to work trying to break the code.

That looks like a lot of hard work.

Yes, and it's even harder when people keep talking to me...

complete

Those Bandits are never going to stop unless we defeat their boss.

Bandits have a boss?

Yes, a big brute of a nightmare called Mondo.

Mondo?  I might have seen him before.

I need you to go out and defeat him.

But be careful that he doesn't squash you with that club of his.

Maybe I should get some friends to join me.

That's a good idea.

You may need a lot of help.

Defeat Mondo, then return to the Hwarang.

Wow, that was a hard fight.

Did you defeat Mondo like I asked?

Yes, Mondo was one big Nightmare.

Wow, I didn't think it would be easy.

complete

I wish I knew someone strong.

Well... I'm strong.

No, no.  I mean someone who knows how to fight.

Well... I know how to fight.

You don't understand. Someone needs to go out and defeat that big nightmare,
Malagant.

He's the leader of the monsters around here, and only a really powerful Archon
could defeat him.

I'm standing right here, dummy!

Oh, you want to try to beat Malagant?

I don't think it's a good idea, but I wish you luck.

Defeat the nightmare leader Malagant, then return to me.

I did it!  I defeated Malagant!

What?  You?

Yes, me!  How could you doubt me, after all I've done?

I always just thought of you as my helper. Who knew that you were so
strong!

complete

Excuse me, but could you come over here for a second?

Yes?  What is it?

If you don't mind, I would like to ask you for a favor.

A favor?

I used to live in the village before the nightmares overran us.

Oh no!  Did all of your family escape with you?

Yes, luckily we all made it safely.

If only the troops had arrived sooner...

The troops arrived just soon enough to save your family.

I guess that's true.

And as soon as we drive out the nightmares, you can go back to farming
again.

Actually, not without my Seeds.

What happened to your Seeds?

The nightmares stole them even before we had to evacuate.

They stole Seeds from Hobaki as well.

These nightmares are smart.  They know how to hit us where it hurts.

What did we ever do to them?

I know what I'm going to do to them.

I'm going to hunt those Bandits down and take your Seeds back.

Maybe then they'll get the message not to steal our food.

Thank you so much!

I'll be right back with your Seeds.

Please collect thirty Seeds from Bandits, then return to me.

Here are thirty Seeds.  That should get you started.

How can I ever pay you back?

No need.  I couldn't just leave you here to starve.

You've saved the lives of me and my family.

Your crops feed a lot more people than just your family.

I suppose that's true.  The community needs us.

Exactly.  If we don't stick together, then we'll all be lost.

Still, I'd like to show my gratitude for your hard work.

Well... okay.  There's nothing wrong with a little gratitude!

complete

Thank you so much!

Why are you thanking me again?

I heard that you broke the nightmares' spell of fear!

Ah, yes.  It was tough, but someone had to do it.

Now maybe our troops will take a more active role against the nightmares.

We need everyone to pitch in.

You might want to join up, as long as your farm is in the hands of the
nightmares.

Oohh.... eesh.

What's wrong?

It's just that...

Don't you want to take your farm back from those monsters?

Yes I do.  I really do!  But...

But what?

I don't think all of that fear spell has been removed.

Every time I think about those nightmares, I almost faint.

No, I'm pretty sure the spell is gone.

I'm telling you that I'm still afraid!

And I'm telling you that it's not some spell's fault.

Look, could you just humor me?

Maybe if you take out a few more of those withered nightmares,
I'll get my bravery back.

You're not the only person who's afraid.

After my farm was overrun, you'd think I'd be ready to fight.

And yet every time I think about joining up with the guards,
I get weak in the knees.

Okay.  I might as well help you.

I think that if you defeated twenty Withered Matrons and twenty
Withered Elders, it would help.

I guess I've got to fight nightmares one way or another.

Please defeat twenty Withered Matrons and twenty Withered Elders,
then return to me.

How do you feel now?

Did you defeat those nightmares?

Yep, I got twenty of each.

Oh that's great to hear.  I'm feeling braver already!

So you're going to go sign up.

Uh... give me a little bit.  I'm still gathering my strength.

Sure you are.  Good luck with that.

dialogue.text:
Liam's my name and trade is my game!

I don't remember asking for that information.

I hear that you're a top gun at hunting nightmares.

You might say that.

I did say that!  Is it true?

Sure.

Swell!  I have just the right job for you!

How would you like to collect items for me?

That sounds like a waste of time.

Wait a minute.  Allow me to explain!

Go right ahead.

I deal in rare and interesting artifacts from around the dreamworld.

I've heard that nightmares in this area have really cool Masks. 

I want you to collect those Masks for me to sell.

Who would want to buy those horrible things?

You let me worry about that.  Remember, I pay well!

Okay, but I'm only getting you ten of each.

Collect ten Matron Masks and ten Elder Masks, then return to me.

Be careful with these things.

Yes, I know.  They might have a spell on them.

I'm pretty sure I got rid of the spell, but it might come back.

Risk is a part of every business transaction.

Sure.  Now about the payment part...

Payment?

Yes!  You said that if I perform this pointless task, you'd pay me.

Haha!  Just kidding.  Here you go.

I guess this will do.

Please collect ten Coin Wallets from Withered Matrons and Elders,

I found some of your Coin Wallets, and they're still stuffed with cash.

Oh, happy day!  

"Happy day?"  Really?

dialogue.text:
You are differenf from the others.

Why do you say that?

There is no fear in your eyes.

So you're saying that everyone else is afraid?  That isn't very nice.

The Archons of this area are paralyzed with fear.

One must not be afraid to face the harsh realities of life.

Why is that?

The withered nightmares of this area spread fear wherever they go.

You mean Withered Elders and Matrons?

Yes.  

Psh.  They're not much different from any other nightmare.

I see them all the time, and I don't run away.

That is because you did not fall under their spell of fear.

You have a very powerful mind.

Well, I am pretty good at math...

Not like that.  I mean you are brave and honest with yourself.

I see.  So should I teach other people to think more like me?  

We can't change the way people think.

We'll have to break the spell of the withered nightmares.

Sounds great.  How do we do that?

You must collect ten Masks from Withered Matrons and bring them to
Kong.

What is he going to do with them?

If he shows them to the citizens, the spell will break and they won't be as
afraid.

Sounds good to me.  I'll get on my way.

Collect ten Masks from Withered Matrons and deliver them to
General Kong.

Are you busy, General Kong?

Yes.  What do you want?

A Monk told me to show you these Masks.

Gah!  Oh, you frightened me!

Yes, everyone seems to be afraid of them.

Actually, now that you mention it, they're not that frightening.

The Monk told me that I could break the spell by showing people these Masks.

In that case, I'll hand them out to the troops so they aren't affected by the spell.

Nice thinking.  Good luck.

complete

It seems that fear can come from both internal and external sources.

Are you talking to me?

Ah. It's you again, traveler. I want to thank you again for improving the morale
of our troops.

So the soldiers aren't afraid anymore?

Unfortunately, an evil presence is still spreading fear throughout Monato Esprit.

A nightmare is at the heart of the trouble.  Of course.

Yes, a terrible undead monster called a Revenant.

Oooh, a chill ran down my spine!

Just hearing the creature's name is bad enough.

Do not take this creature lightly.  It can swallow your soul with a single glance!

I think the fear has gotten into you as well, Monk. I'll put a stop to this
nightmare once and for all.

Defeat the Revenant, then return to me.  

I have returned.

My spirit feels lighter than it has in weeks.  Did you succeed?

Yes, I put an end to that undead monster. 

Wonderful.  The soldiers already look like they have more spring in their step.

Now they don't have any more excuses.

Yes, with the magical fear gone, I'm sure they will fight harder.

complete

It's nice to finally meet you after hearing so much about you.

I'm team leader of Patrol Squad Bravo.

Nice to meet you as well.

We here in Patrol Squad Bravo appreciate everything you've been doing.

Well, give my thanks to Patrol Squad Bravo.

Maybe when things quiet down, you can meet the rest of the fellas.

Sure, that'd be swell.

How are things going, by the way?

It's hard.  The monsters in this area are very strong.

What kind of monsters you do get around here?

We get plenty of Bandits, as well as Withered Elders and Withered Matrons. 

The worst are the soldiers from the Saulabi army.

An army of nightmares?

Yes.  They look almost like Archons, which is very confusing.

Hmm, that sounds like something I should look into.

If you'd collect some of their Swords that would help us out a lot.

Anything else?

Now that you mention it, I'd like to get a look at those Certificates that they have.

Concentrate on the Saulabi Swordsmen and collect their Swords and Certificates.

Okay.  I'll get started right away.

Defeat 20 Saulabi Swordsmen. Collect 10 of their Swords and 15 of their
Certificates.

Here are those items you requested.

Hmm, these are very interesting. Both the Certificates and the Swords look like
they're made out of some sort of crystal.

I should show these to my Squad Commander.

What about the other Saulabi nightmares?

Oh yes, there are also Sorceresses.  Patrol Squard Alpha handles them.

I see.  Perhaps I should seek out their team leader.

complete

Greetings.  I'm team leader of Patrol Squad Alpha!

Hello, team leader.  I heard that you might need help studying the Saulabi.

Who told you that?

The team leader for Squad Bravo.

Oh, I see.  Our team is much more organized than Team Bravo.

Really?  Why is that?

Because I'm the team leader of course!

So you don't need my help?

I don't need your help, but I'll take it. I wouldn't be a very good team leader if I
refused.

So what do you want me to do?

What did Team Bravo have you do?

I collected the Swords and Certificates of Saulabi Swordsmen.

Then I'll ask you to collect the Wands and Certificates of Saulabi Sorceresses.

Sounds like good leadership to me.

Defeat 20 Saulabi Sorceresses.  Collect 15 of their Certificates and  10 Wands.

Don't underestimate those Sorceresses.  They're nightmares through and through.

Did you get the... whatever it was that I asked you to get?

Yes, here are your Wands and Certificates.

Wands and Certificates?

What am I supposed to do with these?

The other team is studying them to get an advantage over the nightmares.

Oh, well that's what Team Alpha is going to do.
